    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    is_empty = (bins == bins[0]) & (rem == bins[0] - item)

    empty_indices = np.where(fit & (bins == np.max(bins)))[0]

        pass
    else:
        scores[fit & (rem == np.max(bins))] *= 0.5
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    normalized_rem = rem[fit] / (max_cap + 1e-8)
    
    # Piecewise harmonic scoring: penalize both near-zero remnants (fragmentation) and large remnants (wasted space)
    harmonic_score = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(normalized_rem - 0.25))
    
    # Adaptive variance penalty based on overall bin fullness
    mean_bin_cap = np.mean(bins)
    variance_penalty = np.var(bins / (max_cap + 1e-8))
    
    scores[fit] = harmonic_score - (0.1 * variance_penalty * (bins[fit] / max_cap))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    ratio = rem / max_cap
    scores = np.where(is_empty, -50.0, np.where(valid, -np.exp(ratio) - np.log(1.0 - ratio + 1e-5), -np.inf))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & (rem == max_cap - item)
    used_capacity = max_cap - bins
    avg_used = np.mean(used_capacity[used_capacity > 0]) if np.any(used_capacity > 0) else 0.0
    balance_bonus = np.exp(-0.5 * np.abs((max_cap - rem) - avg_used))
    waste_penalty = np.exp(-1.5 * rem)
    scores[fit] = 1.5 * balance_bonus[fit] + 3.0 * waste_penalty[fit]
    scores[fit & is_empty] *= 0.2
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & (rem == max_cap - item)
    used_capacity = max_cap - bins
    avg_used = np.mean(used_capacity[used_capacity > 0]) if np.any(used_capacity > 0) else 0.0
    balance_bonus = np.exp(-np.abs((max_cap - rem) - avg_used))
    waste_penalty = np.exp(-rem)
    scores[fit] = balance_bonus[fit] + 2.0 * waste_penalty[fit]
    scores[fit & is_empty] *= 0.4
